context.why: US1 built and accepted the foundation: LimitedAutocompleteMixin, RecordAutocompleteView, the throttles, the project and dataset views and fields in fairdm/contrib/autocomplete (views, fields, throttling, urls; tests in tests/test_contrib/test_autocomplete/). Read what US1 wrote and follow its patterns exactly; extend, do not restructure. US2 adds the sample and measurement views (with type detail, local ID, identifiers, exact-first) and their field pairs, the depends_on argument (narrowing by another field on the same form, validated from the bound form's data, never the page request), and moves MeasurementFormMixin.sample to SampleChoiceField(depends_on='dataset'). Keep the approved row template autocomplete/record_option.html. Decisions D14-D16 (US1): default rates on the throttle classes; a form with no request keeps its given queryset; tests pinning the old widget of a moved field are rewritten.
prior_decisions: D1: a field that places a record inside another needs edit; linking needs view; a public list filter offers public records only, to everyone.
D3: visibility rules are taken as they stand (project by visibility; dataset by get_visible on all_objects; sample/measurement by public+published dataset).
D4: a stored link to a record the editor cannot see is kept and shown as a private record without its name.
D12: limits on the pattern of fairdm/api/throttling.py, refused before any query.

D13: design review. django-tomselect rebuilds the validation view as view_class() (lazy_utils.py:107) and with the current page's q/f/e. So: one view subclass per scope (scope is a class attribute), and FairDM fields validate through the view's offered(user, owner=, type=, depends_on=) and never call django-tomselect's clean(). Use django-tomselect's allowed_filter_fields and allowed_ordering_fields, not a custom allow-list.
Upstream gaps are tracked in this repository's issue #554. Put '#554' in the comments of the two django_tomselect templates.
FR-021 (the 'searching is paused' message) is with the maintainer. Do NOT build it and do NOT write a skipped test for it.
